exceptions.finding: 40 HTML sinks insert markup built from template literals, with values escaped by the project's own K.esc / esc instead of a maintained sanitizer (admin.html 18, index.html 12, common.js 9, learning.html 1). common.js:304 interpolates the join code unescaped (#16).
exceptions.reason: Moving every view to DOM building with textContent, or adding a maintained sanitizer with its dependency record, touches every page; it is planned file by file in #7, admin.html first.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Every interpolated text value goes through K.esc / esc (the one known raw value, the join code, is digits from this device's own core, #16). The static-analysis job reports every site in these files as a warning, so a new one shows in each PR, and the PR review rejects new sinks. No script from another origin runs on these pages, and the session cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict.
